detailed_description:
The target video is a 15-second lo-fi phone-recorded vlog with a casual feel: mild indoor sensor noise, imperfect white balance, a single cool-toned hard ceiling light with hard shadows, no retouching or filters, and a fixed phone-tripod camera position with only hard cuts — no sliders, jibs, panning, or tracking.
[Shot 1] The video opens with a slight high angle looking down at the bed. <Subject 3> fills the frame: the banana-print bedsheet with natural fabric wrinkles below, the wall-mounted American flag and slightly casual dorm clutter in the background. <Subject 1>'s real hands and forearms enter frame and open the pale-yellow corrugated cardboard box sitting on the bed, lifting the flaps to reveal <Subject 2> — the magenta flamingo & pineapple beachwear set — neatly arranged inside. The hand movements are snapped to the rap beat, with slight motion blur on the quick flap-open. Corrugated cardboard texture, cotton bedsheet weave, and glossy print reflections catching the hard ceiling light all remain visible. The white-background black-text caption fixed at the top of frame reads "Summer just got way more fun!"
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, a hard cut to a tight close-up from the same fixed tripod position: <Subject 2> is spread flat on the banana-print bedsheet. The vivid magenta print — pink flamingos, pineapples, bananas, and teal palm leaves — is displayed in full; glossy print reflections shift as a hand briefly enters frame to smooth the fabric, the motion carrying slight beat-synced motion blur. Visible cotton weave, halftone-dot print texture, and random natural fabric wrinkles emphasize the real material feel. The caption reads "This flamingo & pineapple set is EVERYTHING for beach days, BBQs, and pool parties!"
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, a hard cut to an eye-level medium shot. <Subject 1> now wears <Subject 2> oversized — camp shirt, bucket hat, and drawstring shorts — standing in <Subject 3> with the American flag and dorm background visible behind him. He adjusts the collar and the hat brim, tugs the shirt hem to show the print's completeness, and gently sways his body to the rap rhythm with excited, expectant energy — small beat-synced movements with occasional motion blur. The glossy print areas shift reflectively as he moves. On the final beat he holds a confident pose. The caption reads "Soft, comfy, and the cutest tropical print — you'll stand out everywhere you go!"

Minimal diegetic sound: faint natural dorm-room ambience (soft room tone) sits under the music; no dialogue or voiceover. All cuts land on the beat.
